LESSON: LISTENING AND SPEAKING 8.1.2 SPEAKING FLUENCY SOUNDS

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 8
Topic 8.1: Listening and Speaking 8.1.2 Speaking Fluency sounds
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 8.1.2 Speaking Fluency sounds, part of Strand 8 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why is it necessary to tell a story accurately, expressively and at the right speed?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. work with others to role play a dialogue on health and safety that features synonyms, antonyms and homophones. Safety 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening and Speaking 8.1.2 Speaking Fluency sounds together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.
